movelist.name: Synthesis
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value instead. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value instead.

movelist.name: Leech Seed
movelist.effect: At the beginning of each of the target’s turns, Leech Seed’s target loses a Tick of Hit Points. Leech Seed’s user then gains Hit Points equal to the amount the target lost. Leech Seed lasts until the target faints or is returned to a Poké Ball. Grass Types and targets immune to Grass Attacks are immune to Leech Seed.

movelist.name: Earthquake
movelist.effect: Earthquake can hit targets that are underground, including those using the Move Dig.

movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Curse
movelist.effect: If the user is not a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of EOT, and when used the user lowers its Speed by -1 Combat Stage, but raises Attack and Defense by +1 Combat Stage each.  If the user is a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of Scene, and when used the user loses 1/3rd of their Max Hit Points and a target Pokémon or Trainer within 8 meters of the user becomes Cursed. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented in any way.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Critical Hits; they are instead normal hits. Defensive.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Execute Keyword. If a single source of Damage or Hit Point Loss would cause the user to lose more than X Hit Points, the damage or Hit Point loss is instead reduced to X. X is equal to 50% of their Max Hit Points. Defensive.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.effect: Whenever the user is returned to its Poké Ball or Takes A Breather, it may activate Natural Cure to cure itself of all Persistent Status Afflictions.
